title: Acme Notes example: exact text and handwriting look
heading: Which ideas from this source should go into the pipeline?
description: Evidence page for the ideas tested from one outside source (fictional example).
meta: run by Developer A, written by the researcher
lede: What we read, what we tested, what we saw. Small samples: evidence, not statistics.

board.intro: One row per idea. Adopt = build; Test more = promising; Drop; Fix = a defect found on the way; Inconclusive = the test could not answer.

rows.idea: Quote exact text in the prompt plus a reference picture
rows.evidence: Sign read correctly in 3 of 3 (T1) against an invented word without it.
Cast changed between shots in 2 of 2 (T2).

sections.title: Exact on-screen text
sections.text: Variant A: a sign described vaguely. Variant B: the exact text in quotes plus the sign's reference picture.
sections.question: Is the sign's text right?

review.compare: Only used when blind is true. Two ways of doing the same thing, shown in shuffled order.
questions: Does the result match the description?
review.guess: Which one do you think used the new wording?
review.cues: If you notice anything odd, write it down.
